rows.concrete_observation: Actual mod constructor registers PROXY instance on Forge bus; ClientProxy declaration extends CommonProxy, so common handlers are registered via chosen proxy. Native onLivingDamage cancels only when victim isTamed, source.getDirectEntity is Player, isPetOf(player,victim), and player not shift. isPetOf accepts victim.isAlliedTo(player) OR one-way same-owner resolution, not simply same stored owner UUID. isTamed supports configurable modified Fox/Rabbit/Frog/Axolotl plus TamableAnimal. One-way resolves loaded owner objects, compares other pet owner or direct target equality; same-owner helper is bidirectional wrapper, not another gate. EntityMixin alliance override only forces true if BOTH entities are tamed and have same owner; ordinary Player alliance branch still relies engine behavior not newly expanded. Fox modified adapter counts trusted UUID presence as tame (config enabled), picks trusted0 else1 and resolves getPlayerByUUID in current level; setTame empty, setter adds trusted UUID, not direct exclusive-owner replacement. Non-shift own/allied direct player damage denied; shift skips only this policy, no guarantee final hit succeeds. Other players/direct mobs/projectiles are not universally denied by this shown branch. No feedback from this branch. Full earlier onLivingHurt remains separate LivingAttack handler: protected pet source/type branches, tamed attacker secondary abilities and cue/impulse may execute on attack attempts before any final settlement; exact event ordering is engine context and not runtime proven. onLivingDamage can additionally ceil amount*.7 for tamed attacker immaturity after its cancel without early return.
rows.application_to_boss_immune: A no-damage outcome may reflect explicit friendly-hit safety with a deliberate opt-in gesture, not Boss intrinsic immunity. Feedback should describe the actual policy, distinguish direct attacker from attributed owner, and never treat source/gesture fallthrough as accepted damage. Late damage cancellation cannot alone promise earlier ability/effect/cue suppression. Useful counterexample for truthful refusal wording; no new PVP/pet mechanism authorized by research.
